recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered composition featuring a male portrait framed by a doorway, overlaid with heavy industrial textures, spray-painted stencil typography, and a ghostly skeletal graphic in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's arm creates a diagonal frame within the vertical doorway
The bright yellow stencil block anchors the bottom third against dark olive tones
The translucent skeletal overlay provides a narrative depth to the flat background
Spray paint overspray links the sharp typography to the organic photographic elements
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the subject's face
Gritty, speckled texture across all layers
Muted olive-green and ochre-yellow color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right third, framed by a doorway, medium shot from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright yellow horizontal block containing the primary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the raised arm down through the doorway, and settles on the bold stencil text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left two-thirds of the upper half are occupied by a textured, dark background with a faint skeletal graphic.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool Blue-Grey (Subtle tones in the subject's shirt and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the yellow block and dark surroundings.

letterConstructionRules: Stencil-style cuts (bridges) in circular and enclosed characters
Soft, rounded corners suggesting spray paint bleed
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and A characters feature vertical or diagonal stencil breaks
G has a simplified, blocky terminal

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated via transparency and spray effects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text to maintain industrial consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic industrial stencil look with appropriate breaks.
For a more abstract, geometric stencil approach.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A moody portrait of a man in a doorway on the right, high contrast lighting. The left side is a dark olive textured wall with a faint, translucent skeletal ribcage graphic. Apply heavy film grain and a horizontal yellow spray-paint band across the bottom third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase stencil-style text over the yellow band. The text should have soft edges and a slight dark overspray effect to look like it was spray-painted through a physical stencil.

verificationChecks: Does the yellow block have spray-paint texture at the edges?
Is the skeletal graphic subtle and translucent?
Is the subject framed by the doorway architecture?

adjustableVariables: Width of the yellow stencil block
Amount of spray paint overspray around letters
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Strong chiaroscuro lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible stencil bridges in all letters
Ensure the yellow block looks like paint, not a solid digital rectangle
Verify the subject's face is not obscured by the text
Confirm the color palette remains in the olive/ochre range
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast doorway portrait with a textured industrial background, then anchor the composition with a heavy, spray-painted stencil text block in a contrasting earthy tone.
